test_series_item: test the Series.item() method extracts a single value from a one-element series
test_series_item_empty: test Series.item() raises ValueError when called on an empty series
test_series_item_incorrect_shape: test Series.item() raises ValueError when called on a multi-element series
test_series_item_with_index: test Series.item(index) extracts a value at the given index including negative indices
test_series_item_out_of_bounds: test Series.item() raises IndexError when the index is out of bounds
